boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented campus environments for individual work, group work, research, tutoring, and computer-based study.

cards.title: Allen Family Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, first floor
cards.notes: Set up at the first-floor Learning Commons when you want individual or collaborative seating near the library service desk and academic-support offices.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor library setting with seating for both solo and collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: McKillop Library identifies the Allen Family Learning Commons as a first-floor area with seating for group and individual study.
cards.access_notes: Located on McKillop Library's first floor; consult current library access information before visiting.

cards.title: Study Room 217
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use this named second-floor study room for a focused session; check the library's current room-booking availability before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated study room on McKillop Library's second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: McKillop Library's floor plan lists Study Room 217 on the second floor.
cards.access_notes: Room availability may be managed through the library's study-room booking process.

cards.title: Curriculum Resource Center
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, second floor
cards.notes: Bring education research or lesson-planning work to the Curriculum Resource Center, then use the nearby tables for individual or group work.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor resource center with study tables and education-focused materials.
cards.evidence_claim: McKillop Library places the Curriculum Resource Center on its second floor, which also has tables for group and individual study.
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of McKillop Library.

cards.title: McKillop Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, second floor
cards.notes: Choose the Makerspace when a class project needs hands-on production; the library lists a Cricut, laminator, button maker, and craft supplies.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on second-floor workspace with making tools and supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: McKillop Library lists its Makerspace on the second floor and identifies a Cricut machine, laminating machine, button maker, and craft supplies.
cards.access_notes: Tool use and material availability may have library-specific requirements; ask library staff before beginning a project.

cards.title: Study Room 304
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, third floor
cards.notes: Reserve or check availability for this third-floor room when you need a defined study setting near the silent floor and main book collection.
cards.short_summary: A named study room on the library's designated silent floor.
cards.evidence_claim: McKillop Library's floor plan lists Study Room 304 on the third floor, its designated silent floor.
cards.access_notes: Room availability may be managed through the library's study-room booking process.

cards.title: Study Room 306
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, third floor
cards.notes: Use this named third-floor room for structured study time, and plan around the library's current room-booking availability and building access.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated room located among the library's quiet third-floor spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: McKillop Library's floor plan lists Study Room 306 on the third floor.
cards.access_notes: Room availability may be managed through the library's study-room booking process.

cards.entity_name: University Archives & Special Collections Reading Room
cards.title: University Archives & Special Collections Reading Room
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, Room 305
cards.notes: Plan archival research around the reading room in Room 305; contact Archives & Special Collections first to confirm researcher access and procedures.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated reading room for working with Salve Regina archival and special-collections materials.
cards.evidence_claim: McKillop Library's floor plan identifies the University Archives & Special Collections office and Reading Room as Room 305 on the third floor.
cards.access_notes: Researcher access and material handling are subject to Archives & Special Collections procedures.

cards.entity_name: McKillop Library Third Floor Silent Floor
cards.title: McKillop Library Third Floor Silent Floor
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, third floor
cards.notes: Head to the library's designated silent floor when uninterrupted reading or writing is the goal, using its book collection and quiet environment.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent level with the main collection and computer access.
cards.evidence_claim: McKillop Library describes its third floor as the designated silent floor and says it includes the main collection, computers, and private carrels.
cards.access_notes: Maintain the floor's designated silent-use environment; consult current library access information before visiting.

cards.title: McKillop Library Private Carrels
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, third floor
cards.notes: Take a private carrel on the third floor when you need a personal desk-like space for reading, note-taking, or sustained computer work.
cards.short_summary: Individual workstations in the library's quiet third-floor environment.
cards.evidence_claim: McKillop Library lists private carrels for individual study on its third floor.
cards.access_notes: Located on the designated silent floor; availability is first-come unless the library announces otherwise.

cards.title: Mercy Commons
cards.subtitle: Garden level of Our Lady of Mercy Chapel
cards.notes: Use Mercy Commons for a change of setting: the university describes a large, comfortable student-center space where students can study and meet.
cards.short_summary: A chapel-level student center that explicitly includes space to study.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve Regina states that Mercy Commons provides a large, comfortable space where students can study, and identifies it as a student center with study space.
cards.source_title: Center for Spiritual Life | Salve Regina University
cards.access_notes: Located on the garden/lower level of Our Lady of Mercy Chapel; confirm building access before visiting.
